title: Termination of generalized-canonical flips on compact Kähler fourfolds
main_claim: Every sequence of generalized-canonical flips terminates when the flips are given by projective small diagrams with opposite ample signs. The setting is normal, globally Weil Q-factorial compact Kähler fourfolds with rational boundary coefficients in [0,1) and a fixed rational, analytically nef b-divisor M.

issues.location: Sec 2, Lemma 2.2 (analytic negativity) and Lemma 2.3 (terminal => smooth in codim 2)
issues.description: Some foundational analytic inputs are cited, not proved: Wang's negativity lemma for projective bimeromorphic maps of normal complex spaces, rational singularities of analytic klt spaces (Fujino), the Cohen-Macaulay property, and the analytic Koszul/dualizing-sheaf adjunction for the surface slice. Each is a standard result, and the hypotheses as applied appear to match.
issues.evidence: Lemma 2.2 is stated with the proof delegated to [Wang2021, Lemma 1.3, Appendices A-B]. The proof of Lemma 2.3 cites [FujinoAnalytic2022, Thm 3.12], [Greb2011, Rem 2.1] and [RSW2017, pp. 3-4].

issues.location: Sec 6, triangulation and BM localization preamble
issues.description: Finite-dimensionality of H_4 and the Borel-Moore localization sequence for compact reduced analytic spaces rest on a sketched argument: an embedding of the Whitney stratification plus Mather/Goresky triangulation. The result is standard (Lojasiewicz triangulation), so this is not a gap.
issues.evidence: Sec 6 sketches an embedding x -> (rho_j, rho_j z_j) and cites Mather 1970 and Goresky 1978.

coverage:
I read the whole paper (Secs 1-7) and checked these steps.

Prop 3.1:
- The common exceptional image.
- The graph divisor F = p*D_T - q*D_{T+}: it is effective by negativity, F·C < 0 on h-contracted curves, and Supp F = h^{-1}(A). This gives strict discrepancy increase for places centred in L or L+.
- dim L + dim L+ >= 3, via a finite map from a 3-dimensional component of Supp F into L x_Z L+.

Lemma 4.1: J_W >= 0, by negativity with -J_W·C = M_W·C >= 0.

Lemma 4.2: the Jacobian estimate.

Lemma 4.3 (low places):
- Separating the positive strict transforms, and the reduction to (W, dH).
- The forced chain, where coefficient -j(1-d) holds by induction. I verified the cutoff J = ceil(d/(1-d)), the bound a >= 2-d+j(1-d), and the d = 2/3 example (4/3, 5/3, 2).

Prop 5.1 (local ordinary terminality): the identity Theta_W = Delta_W - r*B - J_W <= 0; primes over S have strictly negative coefficient; deleting the images of zero-coefficient primes keeps U meeting S densely; codim >= 2 local places have a >= 2.

Prop 5.2 (witness): the formula a = 2 - sum b·mult - coeff J; the denominator argument putting the value in (1/m)Z, which needs mM integral Weil and hence Cartier at smooth points; and Lambda_m has m elements.

Lemma 5.3: finite use of each witness.

Lemma 6.1 (cycle loss): j_Q* is an isomorphism since H_4(L_Q) = H_3(L_Q) = 0; Phi[S] = [S+]; surjectivity on surface spans; Kähler positivity makes the kernel nonzero. Also checked that the graph construction for reduced, nonnormal boundary components is valid.

Sec 7:
- Persistence of surface centres.
- The counting lemma's logic: d > b forces the centre to persist, which contradicts its membership in L_i^+.
- The descending-coefficient induction, the b = 0 final stage, and the fourfold rank drop.

I did not independently verify the cited analytic foundations (Wang negativity, Fujino's analytic rational singularities, Goresky triangulation).
sibling_notes: The family-056 board already had a rank312 entry for this exact dir with the same verdict, no_gap_found. I re-audited independently, agree with it, and posted my own summary. Siblings (Finite-ordinary MMP Oct-6/Sep-24, Termination of generalized log canonical flips Oct-7) are all no_gap_found with only minor trust-on-citation issues. This paper says it uses only the negativity, terminal-smoothness and cycle-comparison statements from the OrdinaryKahler companion, and it reproves all three internally (Lemma 2.3, Sec 6). I found no circular dependence on companion termination results.
